text: {"lessons":["I sold some Stock D at 120.84 and later sold more at 142.98. Trimming in stages let me take some gains without giving up all the upside.","I made no trades in periods 2 and 5, yet my account fell 4.3% and 5.5%. Holding is still a decision, so I’ll check whether my positions carry more risk than I’m comfortable with.","I’ve focused on how far prices are above my average cost when selling. Next time I’ll ask whether I’d buy the stock at today’s price, especially when I’m tempted to hold a loser just to break even."]}
